## Activity

Central Eye Clinic recorded 180 captures during November 2018. This provides the activity total for the reporting period and establishes the volume reviewed in the associated image-quality and grading measures. The capture count should be read alongside the results reported below when considering the clinic’s operational performance for the month.

## Image quality

A total of 5 captures were marked ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.8 per cent of captures. This measure identifies images that could not be used for grading and should continue to be monitored as part of routine site operations. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk so that relevant problems are recorded and followed up through the appropriate process.

## Grading

The grading outcome included 27 results classified as referable. The median grading wait was 7 days. These figures summarise the grading position for Central Eye Clinic in November 2018. Together, the activity, image-quality and grading measures provide a concise account of service performance for the reporting period. Further review should consider the ungradable images, referable results and grading wait alongside routine operational records.
